wholePhysicalScope: The named mosque outline is identical in the native OpenStreetMap and Overture sources. The adjacent Midan Hussein boundary and western pedestrian street identify the forecourt and entry frontage.
lodDetails: Four detail levels preserve the Gothic mosque front, two minarets and forecourt canopies.
limitations: The mosque envelope and plaza orientation are mapped. The unequal heights of the minarets, side and rear entrances, exact dome location and roof level changes are estimates.
The model shows the exterior mosque and its three forecourt umbrellas opened to their documented shading area. The umbrellas are represented in one static state.
The closest mesh represents Gothic foliage and corbel carving in simplified geometry. Minor contemporary equipment, furnishings, human figures, and neighboring bazaar buildings are outside scope.
